title: Minigame: B25.2 Blaze SMOKE

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the B25.2 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a board where a wreck or terrain burns, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): what a Blaze adds to a LOS through its Location is asked of what burns, the wind, and a Fire Lane on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: What a burning wreck, a terrain Blaze, or a Flame adds to a LOS, in each wind.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
